purpose: Bring trusted family-owned TeX and SVG compositions into the shared proof, provenance, and coverage system without replacing their typesetting.
coverage_rules: Only a selected-for-now light output with an explicit baseline slot can be built as a baseline proof; proposed routes use a null experimental slot.
A successful build is awaiting visual review and never grants customer approval, public-release clearance, browser verification, or print approval.
Missing slots stay not-run; native sources are never silently replaced by a shared visual template.

native_tex.web_source_state: An exact-byte historical HTML/CSS/assets packet can be retained as source-only. It does not satisfy static-web validation or browser review.
native_tex.trust_boundary: Native TeX is trusted family source. No-shell-escape does not make arbitrary TeX safe to execute. The adapter records rather than rewrites its layout and does not infer semantic role binding from a style manifest.

build_checks: exact source hashes and local links
shared vector, raster, and derived-export representations
native_vector.render_copy: The original SVG and linked raster bytes remain unchanged. A separately hashed render-only SVG embeds exact declared rasters so librsvg can render parent-relative links without losing artwork.
